Regional Sales Manager / Marketing Manager

**Role Description**


The Specialist Software Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and evolving next\-generation AI\-powered scientific authoring platforms supporting Research and Preclinical organizations. This role will play a critical part in scaling internal Amgen's AI solutions within Research domains.


The successful candidate will work closely with scientists, informaticians, product managers, architects, and engineering teams to build enterprise\-grade AI solutions leveraging Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic workflows, knowledge management systems, and cloud\-native architectures.


This role requires strong expertise in AI platform engineering, distributed systems, scientific document processing, and cloud technologies. The candidate will provide technical leadership in architecting scalable, reliable, and compliant AI solutions that improve scientific productivity and accelerate research outcomes.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Design full stack solution with scalable backend services, APIs, and distributed systems supporting AI\-driven workflows.
* Lead architecture decisions around scalability, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.
* Develop Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector search solutions, and semantic retrieval frameworks.
* Build and optimize multi\-agent workflows for content generation, critique, review, and refinement.
* Implement source attribution, traceability, and grounding mechanisms for AI\-generated content.
* Develop prompt orchestration, tool integration, and agent execution frameworks.
* Design and implement document ingestion, semantic chunking, embedding generation, and indexing pipelines.
* Build cloud\-native applications leveraging AWS services and modern engineering practices.
* Drive software quality through testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Design and implement AI\-powered scientific authoring and knowledge management platforms.
* Develop integrations with scientific and enterprise data sources.
* Optimize retrieval quality through metadata filtering, hybrid search, and reranking techniques.
* Support structured and unstructured scientific content processing.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience**

* Master's or Bachelor's degree and 8\-12 years of Information Systems experience

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

* 8\+ years of software engineering experience building enterprise applications.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience developing Generative AI or LLM\-powered applications implementing RAG concept.

**Functional Skills:**

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience developing scalable backend applications using Python, Java, or related technologies.
* Strong API design and microservices development experience.
* Strong SQL skills and database design experience.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI platforms.
* Experience implementing RAG architectures and semantic retrieval systems.
* Experience with vector databases such as PGVector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or OpenSearch Vector.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of prompt engineering, grounding, and AI evaluation methodologies.


Cloud \& Platform Engineering

* Hands\-on experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, ECS/EKS, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, and EventBridge.
* Experience building cloud\-native and distributed systems.
* Experience with containerization technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**

* Experience with scientific document processing and OCR technologies.
* Experience with Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or equivalent AI platforms.
* Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps methodologies.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or CloudWatch.
* Experience with scientific authoring, regulatory content management, PKDM, Toxicology, or Research Informatics platforms.

**Professional Certifications (Preferred):**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Machine Learning Specialty
* Generative AI or Cloud AI certifications
* Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD)

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to translate complex scientific and business requirements into technical solutions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global cross\-functional teams.
* High degree of ownership and technical leadership.
* Ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions.
* Strong mentoring and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**


Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking an experienced **Product Manager – AI Solutioning** to drive product vision, strategy and development of innovative AI\-powered solutions. In this role, you will act as the bridge between market needs and business goals, leading product development from concept to production while leveraging advanced AI and technical expertise across domains such as BFSI, Healthcare, Insurance and Life Sciences.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and communicate product vision, mission and roadmap to align teams and stakeholders
* Lead product development with an entrepreneurial mindset and end\-to\-end ownership
* Act as the bridge between market and business to inform product and service design
* Own product and go\-to\-market strategy across the full product life cycle
* Drive business modeling and financials to support product decisions
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify opportunities
* Manage product backlog and change management processes
* Track product success metrics to measure impact and outcomes
* Oversee risk management and mitigation throughout product delivery
* Own AI solutions from concept to production within Agile delivery frameworks
* Apply AI models to improve productivity in product management activities
* Ensure adherence to Responsible AI and ethics standards

**Requirements**

* 10\-15 years of experience in IT with 10\+ years in Product Owner and Product Management roles
* Expertise in BFSI, Healthcare, Insurance or Life Sciences domains
* Proficiency in BPM, Wireframing and Mockup design and demo
* Competency in Product Roadmap Management, Risk Management and Mitigation
* Background in Market and Competitor Analysis, Backlog and Change Management and Product Success Metrics
* Skills in Agile Delivery Methodologies and Agile Product Ownership for AI and data teams
* Knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning and NLP concepts
* Expertise in Computer Vision, Generative AI / LLMs and model training vs model usage trade\-offs
* Understanding of MLOps / LLMOps lifecycle, dataset creation, labeling and quality considerations
* Familiarity with AI evaluation metrics and monitoring strategies
* Capability to perform advanced requirements engineering for AI systems

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

 Amazon's mission is to be 'Earth's most customer\-centric company,' and our award\-winning Customer Service (CS) team is an essential part of that mission. Amazon CS is one of the largest customer service organizations in the world.
   

  

 Our CS Technology organization powers customer service by developing elegant customer and Customer Service Associate (CSA)\-facing products globally. These products offer effortless self\-service and automation solutions to our customers. When customers prefer to interact with a human, we enable CSAs to effectively and elegantly solve customer issues using associate\-facing products powered by human\-centered design.
   

  

 Our team is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Product Manager – Technical to own a critical channel or workstream within our associate\-facing product suite. In this role, you will balance current\-state operational excellence with long\-term platform transformation — ensuring your workstream is stable today while building toward the next generation of dynamic, personalized associate experiences. You will manage escalations and backlog prioritization, integrate new capabilities without degrading the associate experience, and serve as a strong advocate for your workstream across cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 A successful candidate thrives in a highly collaborative, ambiguous, and fast\-paced environment, with a proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership, delivering results at scale, and driving meaningful improvements to both associate and customer experiences.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end associate experience for your designated channel or workstream, driving quality, reliability, and continuous improvement
* Manage escalations and backlog prioritization, ensuring the most impactful improvements are delivered efficiently
* Partner with engineering, design, and operations teams to deliver seamless feature integrations that enhance — rather than disrupt — the associate experience
* Advocate for your workstream in cross\-functional forums, ensuring new platform capabilities account for your channel's unique requirements
* Balance short\-term operational needs with long\-term strategic goals, positioning your workstream for scale and future innovation

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Experience driving platform migrations or workflow modernization initiatives
* Ability to balance short\-term operational needs with long\-term strategic goals
* Experience working across engineering, operations, and business stakeholders

jobs.description:
**Product Leader — Echo** 




*Reports to: Founder \| Engagement: Full\-time \| Location: Hyderabad* 




**Role overview** 




 Owns Echo product end\-to\-end: strategy, roadmap, design, and team build\-out. Partners closely with the Engineering Leader on feasibility and trade\-offs, and with the GTM Leader on customer signal and market positioning. This role is responsible for the product's trajectory from current early deployments through enterprise scale.
 



 Echo is an enterprise conversational BI platform that translates natural language to SQL over SAP and traditional data warehouse systems, with flexible deployment across cloud, private cloud, and fully on\-premise environments (including H100\-class GPU infrastructure for air\-gapped banking and healthcare deployments). The stack combines a fine\-tuned NL\-to\-SQL engine, a semantic layer for business term resolution, and a retrieval layer over schema and historical query patterns, with an evaluation harness for accuracy and hallucination control.
 



**Core responsibilities** 



* Product strategy: positioning, ICP definition, feature prioritization, and competitive differentiation
* Roadmap ownership: quarterly and annual planning, release sequencing, scope discipline
* Product specification: detailed PRDs, design partnership, acceptance criteria
* Customer discovery: structured engagement with active customers and prospects to validate direction
* Compliance and certification track ownership (SOC 2, ISO 27001, sector\-specific certifications as relevant)
* Product team build\-out across designers, PMs, and technical writers as scale demands



**Required experience** 



* 5\+ years in product management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role
* Experience building enterprise B2B SaaS products, ideally in data, BI, or analytics
* Demonstrated ability to own a product from early stage through enterprise scale
* Customer\-facing product discovery experience: structured interviews, win/loss analysis, requirements synthesis
* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade\-offs and feasibility



**Preferred experience** 



* Background with a data, BI, analytics, or developer tools SaaS vendor
* Familiarity with conversational AI, natural\-language interfaces, or LLM\-based products
* Experience with enterprise compliance certifications and procurement processes
* Domain depth in banking or healthcare

The pod is responsible for driving meaningful change in margin call issuance processes, leveraging AI and automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, and user experience.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

**About Deutsche Börse Group:** 




 Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.
 



 Their India centre is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top\-tier tech talent. They focus on crafting advanced IT solutions that elevate market infrastructure and services. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.
 



  





**Corporate IT – together with the CTO Area \- is driving together the Implementation of ServiceNow for IT Service \& Asset Management. This is a multi\-year program professionalizing and standardizing the handling of CMDB, Asset Management, ITSM and other processes/activities. The IT SAM Program is pursuing a.o. following goals:** 



* Deliver a group wide IT Service \& Asset Management Platform in the cloud in line with the enterprise architecture
* Replace legacy technology (CRM7\) to Cloud native technology track
* Drive cultural change form proprietary DBG specific implementation into a SaaS solution



  





**Your Mission:** 




 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Owner to lead the topic of ITSM (for internal \& external users and customers) in our IT Service \& Asset Management (IT SAM) capabilities. You will be at the heart of our digital transformation, driving the implementation and evolution of our new central platform. This is a key role in shifting our culture from a legacy, process\-heavy environment to a modern, cloud\-native, and service\-oriented model.
 



 If you are a practical leader who thinks in terms of products and services that deliver real value, and you are passionate about building modern IT solutions, this is the role for you. We need a doer, not just a theorist, who can cut through complexity and guide our organization towards a more efficient and user\-centric future.
 



  





**Tasks/Responsibilities:** 



* **Own the Product Vision \& Strategy:** 
 You will define and champion a clear product vision for IT Service and Asset Management. You'll translate the strategic goals of our multi\-year transformation program into a prioritized, value\-driven product backlog. This includes owning, developing, maintaining, prioritizing and securing completeness of the Product Backlog with, on top of business requirements, external and internal audit items, BAU activities and Enablers.
* **Lead with a Practical Mindset:** 
 While familiarity with ITIL is essential, your focus will be on practical application. You will pragmatically balance business needs with governance requirements, ensuring we build effective services, not just "paper tiger" processes.
* **Drive Agile Execution** 
 : As the "Voice of the Customer," you will guide our Agile development team. This includes breaking down features into clear user stories, defining objectives, goals and acceptance criteria, and ensuring the team is always working on what matters most. You will be the final authority on accepting work, using Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) practices and practices like Definition of Ready (DoR) and the Definition of Done (DoD), ensuring the final product meets our high standards.
* **Champion Service Adoption \& Value:** 
 You will own the strategy for product adoption, ensuring users understand and benefit from the new platform. A key part of your role will be evaluating new features from our SaaS vendor to ensure we are maximizing the value of our investment.
* **Collaborate and Communicate:** 
 You will be the central point of contact between senior stakeholders, business users, and the development team. Your ability to communicate clearly and manage relationships at all levels will be critical to aligning everyone on the product roadmap and ensuring smooth execution.
* **Manage the Basics:** 
 This includes managing JIRA / Confluence / SharePoint together with the Product Team. Organizing, preparing and following up different types of program meetings. Contributing to program communication content and channels (mail, newsletter, intranet)



  





**Qualifications/required skills:** 



* **Proven Product Ownership Experience:** 
 5\+ years of experience as a Product Owner (or similar role) in a large\-scale, enterprise Agile environment.
* **Deep Domain Expertise:** 
 Strong, hands\-on experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and a deep understanding of the underlying data (CMDB).

 Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing enterprise SaaS solutions (ServiceNow experience is a significant advantage). You understand how to leverage out\-of\-the\-box capabilities over excessive customization.

 You are a strategic thinker who focuses on customer needs and delivering tangible business value. You have a track record of simplifying complex problems and communicating effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Leadership \& Influence:** 
 Excellent communication, negotiation, and decision\-making skills. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and can operate effectively in a multi\-national environment.

 Experience working in the financial services industry or another highly regulated environment is highly desirable.

 Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Basic German is a plus.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.


**Leadership \& Coaching**
* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Partnership**
* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.


**Roadmap, Backlog \& Delivery Governance**
* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:
+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. Are you energised by turning complex financial data into clear, actionable insights? Do you want to be the trusted analytical partner who helps shape decisions across regions and affiliates? You will partner closely with stakeholders, drive process standardisation alongside your manager, and bring our Business Intelligence tools to life.

* **Ownership of standard financial reports for IO/regions/affiliates** – delivering weekly and monthly sales and cost reports, providing analysis on the key drivers of deviations against budget and forecast, performing financial system reconciliations, and preparing monthly performance presentations for business meetings.

* **Driving standardisation alongside your manager** – contributing to continuous improvement of processes, documenting work as per archiving guidelines, and championing better practices as a Finance \& Procurement GBS ambassador.
* **Securing strong collaboration** between GBS and the IO FP\&A team, while supporting colleagues within Finance \& Procurement GBS and ensuring compliance with Novo Nordisk systems and policies.

  


**The Department**



In Finance, Legal \& Global Solutions, we enable Novo Nordisk to fulfil our purpose by safeguarding the business, providing corporate infrastructure, and driving value creation. We are a team of 2,300 colleagues primarily based at our headquarters in Denmark and our Global Business Services centres in India and Mexico.

We pride ourselves on providing superior service to our stakeholders and adding value through process standardisation and efficiency – all in a collaborative, dynamic atmosphere that fosters continuous improvement.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to provide recommendations in spite of uncertainty and pressure, combined with the ability to handle and prioritise several tasks.

* Proficiency in oral and written English and a genuine team\-player attitude.

At Novo Nordisk, every role connects directly to our mission of defeating serious chronic diseases – and Finance \& Procurement is no exception. You will join a team of driven, talented colleagues who share ambition, accountability and a genuine commitment to going further together. Apply Now!

3rd July 2026

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health.  eGovernments Foundation is a leading non\-profit organization dedicated to strengthening public service delivery through scalable technology\-backed solutions. The Foundation works closely with governments to design, deploy, and sustain digital systems that improve outcomes in health, governance, and public administration.
 



  





**About the Project** 




 The 10BedICU Project, launched in 2021, focuses on enhancing critical care capacity in district and sub\-district hospitals across India. The initiative has established 214\+ functional ICUs, supported by centralized Tele\-ICU services and powered by the CARE EMR platform Building on this, the project is now piloting CARE HMIS, a modular, interoperable Health Management Information System aligned with national data standards (FHIR, SNOMED CT). The pilot aims to digitize hospital processes across 30 government health facilities, strengthen documentation practices, and enable data\-driven decision\-making. The National Cancer Grid (NCG) TeleOPD project enables remote oncology consultations between government hospitals and Tata Memorial Hospital using a structured digital platform. It focuses on protocol\-based care, standardized documentation, and training of government clinicians to improve access and continuity of cancer care. The pilot is designed for evaluation and scale\-up across other NCG centres.

 You will own the product experience for CARE HMIS with

* Field adoption: Work with state teams, hospitals, clinicians, Product Ops, Solution Support, and Clinical Validation teams to drive onboarding, training, feedback loops, and daily usage.

As an Architect in the GraphQL Stable team, you will serve as a Tech Lead, responsible for shaping the architecture, design, best practices, and frameworks for GraphQL. * Define and drive GraphQL architecture – Establish the reference architecture, best practices, and architectural guidelines.

* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles – Secure adherence to the North Star architecture and ensure compliance with security directives and policies.

* Strong experience in integration implementation and architecture
* Hands\-on experience in implementing subgraphs and federated super graphs from scratch using any GraphQL platform, with expertise in Schema Design, Queries, Mutations, and Subscriptions.
* Sound knowledge on the Schema governance, GraphQL versioning strategy
* Proficiency in API\-led architecture and experience with API Management tools.
* Expertise in designing and implementing integration architectures
* Familiarity with Observability tools such as OpenTelemetry and Splunk.
* Experience working in Agile environments, with a strong understanding of Agile methodologies.

**Soft Skills:**  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills

* Effective communication and stakeholder management to collaborate across departments.

**Business Systems Analyst, GTM Systems**


Business Technology \| HealthEdge


HealthEdge is in a period of rapid growth and consolidation following recent mergers. The Business Technology team exists to make sure the systems that power our business keep up – not just running, but evolving alongside the teams that depend on them. We’re hiring a Business Systems Analyst to join our GTM Systems team and help us do exactly that.

  

The GTM Systems team owns Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack that powers how our Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services and Support organizations operate. As a BSA, you’ll be a core contributor on that team – building and maintaining solutions, partnering with GTM stakeholders to translate business needs into system changes, and helping the team run well day to day.

  

If you love turning business problems into clean system solutions, are genuinely curious about how AI tools can change the way work gets done, and thrive when you’re learning something new every week – this role is for you.

**In This Role, You’ll Get To**

* Build and ship.
* **Build and ship.** Contribute to Salesforce platform work across your GTM domain – configuration, flows, objects and data – from requirements through deployment and ongoing support.
* **Support AI enablement.** Participate in AI strategy work alongside senior teammates – learning how AI tools like Claude and Salesforce Einstein are applied to GTM workflows and contributing to implementation.

* **Use AI in your work.** Actively use AI tools in your daily workflow – for documentation, analysis, testing and solution design – and help build a team culture where AI\-first is the default.

 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to drive the metrics strategy and data infrastructure for Amazon's Misleading Claims program. This role will define, build, and own the key performance metrics that measure program effectiveness in protecting customers from deceptive product claims across our marketplace. The ideal candidate will independently identify underlying data sources, design new metrics frameworks where none exist, and deliver actionable insights that shape program direction. You will partner with Risk Management, Tech, Science, and Ops teams to translate complex enforcement outcomes into measurable business indicators. Strong analytical judgment, deep SQL proficiency, and experience working with trust and safety or compliance programs are essential. This role requires the ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where data definitions and measurement approaches must be built from the ground up.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end metrics framework for the Misleading Claims program, including identifying gaps in existing measurement, creating new metrics, and establishing baselines and targets for program performance
* Independently identify, evaluate, and onboard underlying data sources across enforcement, detection, and seller behavior systems to build a comprehensive data foundation for program analytics
* Design and build dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide real\-time visibility into program health, enforcement accuracy, detection coverage, and seller impact
* Independently collaborate across cross\-functional teams – Risk, Legal, Operations, Science, Tech, and Finance – to align on metric definitions, data requirements, and reporting cadences
* Provide data\-driven and actionable insights to senior stakeholders to influence roadmaps, prioritize enforcement strategies, and measure the effectiveness of ML/AI detection models
* Develop key performance indicators that track progress against business objectives, including detection precision/recall, false positive rates, enforcement turnaround times, and seller remediation outcomes
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on misleading claims trends, abuse patterns, and enforcement outcomes to identify root causes and recommend program improvements
* Build scalable, repeatable analytical processes and self\-service tools that reduce dependency on ad\-hoc analysis and enable the team to make faster, data\-informed decisions


**About The Team**
 Misleading Claims is part of the Regulatory Intelligence Safety and Compliance (RISC) organization, on a mission to protect customers from false and deceptive claims on products, enabling trustworthy shopping experiences at Amazon. As a newly established enforcement program, we're building comprehensive policies, designing enforcement mechanisms, and developing scalable solutions leveraging ML/AI technologies to safeguard customers across our marketplace. Our team collaborates closely with Product Quality, Legal, Tech, Science, and Operations teams to define and execute misleading claims controls at scale. We're establishing success metrics, creating seller education programs, and implementing a risk\-based approach that balances customer protection with seller success. This is an opportunity to shape a critical trust and safety program from the ground up, with direct impact on customer experience and marketplace integrity.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 2\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with Excel
* Experience with SQL


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience partnering with executive\-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues

jobs.description:
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid\-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
   

  

 At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by
 **our commitment to empowering our employees around the world** 
 .
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 ECI has an exciting opportunity for a
 **Business Analys,** 
 who is responsible plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technology solutions. This individual will work closely with stakeholders across departments to gather, analyze, and document business requirements, ensuring that solutions align with strategic goals and deliver measurable value. The Business Analyst will support project teams throughout the software development lifecycle, from initial concept through implementation and post\-deployment support.
   

  

 This role requires strong analytical thinking, effective communication, and a collaborative mindset to drive process improvements and support enterprise\-wide initiatives.
   

  

 This is a Hybrid role.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document detailed business and functional requirements.
* Own the complete requirement lifecycle from discovery to sign‑off.
* Conduct gap analysis and impact assessments to support change initiatives and solution design.
* ranslate business needs into clear and concise user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Facilitate requirement workshops, sprint planning, and backlog grooming sessions within Agile teams.
* Perform data mapping between source and target systems.
* Act as a primary client‑facing representative for requirement‑related discussions.
* Communicate effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders
* Support the development and QA teams by clarifying requirements and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and validate that delivered solutions meet business expectations.
* Develop and maintain documentation such as BRDs, user stories, wireframes, and process maps.
* Assist in the development of training materials and user guides for new systems or enhancements.
* Monitor project progress and communicate updates to stakeholders and project managers.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization and automation across business functions.
* Ensure traceability of requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
* Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams to ensure mutual understanding and successful delivery.


**Who you are:**
* 8 years of experience as a Business Analyst in a technology\-driven organization.
* Experience with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and MS Visio.
* Demonstrated experience in business requirement gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Experience conducting UAT and working closely with QA teams.
* Familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and project management principles.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio)
* Experience with core software applications, including Office 365 applications (including: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio)
* 2 – 4 years with business analytics solutions (preferably Power BI)
* 2 – 4 years’ experience SQL programming (Good to have)
* Experience of ERP and WMS system concepts
* Practical knowledge in importing data for use in report software, spreadsheets, graphs, and flowcharts.
* Working knowledge of web\-based architectures and technologies (i.e. Web 2\.0, Forums, Wikis, Social Media, etc.)
* Understanding of data modeling, process mapping, and workflow design.
* Awareness of web\-based technologies and digital collaboration tools.


**Bonus points if you have:**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
